notes.title: Small SteamVR patch and bug fix
notes.content:
Hello !

We hope your adventures into Jack's worlds are going well.
Recently, we discovered that there were issues with Meta headsets' controllers that were not correctly recognized by the game when using SteamVR. They were considered as Vive controllers.
Fortunately, we were able to quickly fix the issue, which is included in this patch. Sorry for the inconvenience :)

In addition, we fixed an issue which may have caused a crash or other problems when dying before the first portal of the last level of Army of Evil.
Once again, don't hesitate to reach us if you encounter any issue or if  you have any feedback on the game, it's always a pleasure to read you :)
Enjoy your One True Path !

notes.title: Small Quality Of Life update
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

We just pushed a small update with some quality of life fixes and small improvements:

- Fixed a bug which made the vignette impossible to disable
- Fixed conservation of vignette setting in-game
- Increased smooth turning speed
- Minor fixes and tweaks

We're still working on the 'tracking' issue related to Quests headsets and we should be able to push another update specifically for this next week.

Hope you'll enjoy One True Path and don't hesitate to let us know if you have more feedback!

notes.title: Post-release issues and coming updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

First of all, we'd like to thank you for all your feedback and comments since the release of One True Path. We're really pleased to see you discovering the first part of the story of our friend Jack Stevenson.
However, the game is in Early Access, which means that some bugs may still occur within the game, as some of you have already noticed.

We're actively working on resolving bugs that were identified with your feedback. In the next few days, we are going to release an update to fix the following issues :
[list]

[*] A tracking issue affecting users of Meta headsets (Quest and Rift families), causing some lag with the camera. At first glance, this may seem like a performance problem, but it's a tracking issue. We know how uncomfortable this issue makes the experience, so this is our top priority.

[*] About the vignette settings : it is currently impossible to completely disable the vignette. Also, when its size is adjusted in the settings menu, it is not taken into account in-game. 

[*] In addition to these two issues, we'll also be including a few minor fixes aimed at improving the overall gameplay experience.
[/list]
Finally, we've also heard your feedback on some of the gameplays' features, in particular Army Of Evil's swordfighting. We'll be working to improve the gamefeel of this part of the game, and will keep you informed when we're ready to share improvements in future updates.

See you soon !

The InnerspaceVR Team
